days.title: Arrive on the Shinkansen
days.body: Late-morning arrival, check in at the inn, a walk along the sample riverside.

days.title: Pavilion and Kamo Shojin
days.body: Optional timed tickets at Lantern Garden Pavilion. Evening shojin dinner already booked on Omakase.

days.title: A walking day
days.body: Neighbourhood streets and the river. No reservations on this sample day.

days.title: A slower last full day
days.body: Free day. Spend any leftover IC-card balance.

days.title: Airport express and flight home
days.body: Checkout at 11:00. Airport express to KIX for the afternoon Sample Pacific flight.
